steps: Queueing: add_from_result() queues only NOT_RUN checks, deduped by (slug, check), first reason kept.
Exactly one revisit per pending item at drain; a resolved item leaves the queue.
An unresolved item stays queued with its new reason recorded (revisits, last_status, last_reason on the item).
A revisit exception is recorded as ERROR on the item — never propagated, never dropped.
